title: Pair reading guide v1
description: Every changed file of one PR head, sorted into review, skim or skip. Stored in the evidence ZIP at generated_artifacts/reading_guide.json.

status.description: partial: at least one file carries the not-categorised state (the model ran out of time or omitted it).

counts.description: Computed by code from files; always matches.

files.description: Exactly one entry per changed file, sorted by bucket (review, skim, skip) and then by rank.

path.description: New path; the old path for a deleted file.

rank.description: 1-based order inside the bucket, contiguous, 1 = look first.

reason.description: One plain sentence, at most 25 words. No links or line numbers.

primary_tag.description: The main concern. Always set for review files.

states.description: How the result was produced; see the state_tag descriptions.

skip_kind.description: Set exactly when bucket is skip.

focus.description: Changed lines that carry the concern, most important first.

source.description: rule: the final bucket equals the code rule result. model: the model raised it or decided it.

rule_id.description: The code rule that set a floor, pin or receipt, e.g. pin:ci or receipt:lockfile.

pinned.description: A code rule pins this file to review; the model cannot move it.

authorship.description: Who wrote the changed lines, from captured sessions. Never moves a bucket.

range.description: Inclusive line range inside one hunk with at least one changed line. new = head side, old = base side (removed lines).

oneOf.description: Lockfile that matches its manifest change or a captured install.
Generated path with no captured agent edit.
Whitespace-only change where whitespace has no meaning.
Ordinary docs (not agent instructions) with no changed command or setting, including changesets.
Moved code or an identifier rename that code verified line by line.
The model could not tell what a change does; placed in skim, never skip. Show in UI.
Qualified for review but the review budget was full; placed at the top of skim. Show in UI.
Not judged in this run; placed in skim or its rule floor. Show in UI.
No readable hunks (binary, truncated or hunkless). Show in UI.
Editor or type errors were still open for this file at capture time.
Changed lines could not be traced to a captured request, so scope was not judged.
The model answered below the rule floor; code raised it.
The model's reason failed checks; code wrote a template reason.
A focus range outside the real changed lines was removed.
